tasks.label: PIO: Upload + Monitor (1-click)
tasks.command: python -m platformio run -e esp32_upesy -t upload && python -m platformio device monitor -e esp32_upesy

windows.command: python -m platformio run -e esp32_upesy -t upload ; if ($?) { python -m platformio device monitor -e esp32_upesy }

tasks.label: PIO: Erase + Upload + Monitor (full recovery)
tasks.command: python -m platformio run -e esp32_upesy -t erase && python -m platformio run -e esp32_upesy -t upload && python -m platformio device monitor -e esp32_upesy

windows.command: python -m platformio run -e esp32_upesy -t erase ; if ($?) { python -m platformio run -e esp32_upesy -t upload } ; if ($?) { python -m platformio device monitor -e esp32_upesy }
